p.i: lastini cum Samsone esse Thamnathensis illius generum, inquirendo comperissent, quoniam ille ereptam ei uxorem ejus familiari dedisset, invadunt illos, & mulie-rem, ejusq; patrem igni comburunt. Iudicum 15.

Per eadem tempora, quibus nullus in Israelitis rex erat, Levita quidā in lateribus montis Ephraimitarū peregrinans, uxorem duxerat concubinam à Bethlehe-ma Iudaeae: quae concubina cum parum pudica erga illum fuisset, discessit ab eo, domum patris sui, Bethlehemam Iudaeae. Ibi cum per quatuor menses fuisset, secutus est eam maritus, ut eam blandis ille-ctam verbis reduceret, famulū secum & par asinorum ducens.
Atq; illa eum domum sui patris introduxit, qui puellae pa-ter, hominis adventu delectatus, generi retinuit, secumq; triduo per convivia & noctes habuit.
Quarto die mane cum ge-ner discessum pararet, persuasit socer ut vires cibo recrearet ante discessum.
Deinde cum ambo accubuissent, cibumq; u-

page.notes: The first line is a fragment from the previous page, copied as printed ("lastini", the initial letters are missing). The last word is split by a line-end hyphen ("u-") and continues on the next page; the catchword "nā" is at the lower right and is uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The ligature "st" in "ille-stam" was read as the "ct" ligature of "illectam" and is hyphenated as printed. The heading "LXXII." is set as a bare number and is written as a paragraph, per the rules. The page number is printed "49º" with a ligature, read here as 490.
